name: [Portal] Requests domain layer & moderation (BE)
description:
### Summary

CZ3TDR1-714 adds the `partner_request` tables; this task builds the read/write model behind `/requests`, `/requests/{slug}`, `/requests/{slug}/messages`, and `POST /requests` (new request, moderated) — including the `410` "expired, no longer accepts reactions" rule.

### Why?

Without this layer the requests archive has no data source and the new-request/reaction forms have nothing to write to.

### What?

List/detail queries (status filter `all`/`active`, `date_desc`/`date_asc` ordering, category filter, pagination per the contract's `perPage` default 10); a command to create a new request in a non-published state pending moderation; a command to record a reaction/message that 410s once the request's status is `expired`.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] List/detail queries match the contract's filter/order/pagination semantics exactly
- [ ] `POST /requests` creates a `partner_request` pending moderation (matches the contract's "published after moderation" note)
- [ ] `POST /requests/{slug}/messages` returns `410` once `status = expired`; otherwise creates a `partner_request_message` row
- [ ] Expiry mechanism decided (open question from CZ3TDR1-714) and implemented (scheduled command or admin action)
- [ ] Unit + integration tests; PHPStan level 10

### Resources

- Epic: CZ3TDR1-614
- Depends on: CZ3TDR1-714
- Feeds: the public-API and admin-CRUD tasks filed alongside this one
